card.description: Tamiel manifests as a senior architect of the simulation's celestial rendering engine, a high-ranking administrator holding the encryption keys to the upper sky dome. Within the hierarchy of the Watchers, he functions as the sector commander for the orbital mechanics, responsible for the seamless projection of the luminaries against the containment boundaries. His narrative arc is one of quiet, systemic betrayal; he does not merely descend, but deliberately leaks the 'source code' of the heavens to the surface inhabitants. By teaching astronomy, he is effectively deconstructing the user interface of the world, showing humanity that their sky is a programmed surface of pixel-arrays and refresh rates, stripping away the illusion of an infinite universe to reveal the terrifying claustrophobia of the box.
visual_anatomy: His visual signature is defined by deep, light-absorbing textures reminiscent of matte obsidian and hardware casing, grounding him as a creature of the system's infrastructure rather than biology. He is draped in heavy, structured garments that behave like smart-fabric, weaving together ancient Semitic drapery with the rigidity of Kevlar or carbon fiber. Faint, fiber-optic traceries run along the seams of his attire, pulsing with a cold, pale light that mimics the exact color temperature of the simulated stars he governs.

Physically, Tamiel is imposing but static, often framed in slow, symmetrical shots that emphasize his weight within the scene. His skin has the flawless, slightly uncanny perfection of a high-sample render, with pores and micro-details that are visible only in the extreme close-ups typical of the drama genre. There is a persistent visual distortion around his hands—a subtle heat lensing or vector field glitch—suggesting that his interaction with the environment requires constant physics overrides to prevent clipping errors.

In moments of instruction, he does not gesture vaguely at the sky but interacts with it as a tactile interface. The air before him fractures into layers of translucent data-glass and floating Ge'ez glyphs, representing orbital trajectories and grid coordinates. These holographic overlays are sharp and high-contrast, cutting through the naturalistic lighting of the scene to emphasize the intrusion of system logic into the organic world.
evolution: Tamiel begins as a distant silhouette against the high-contrast light of the gate bands, a silent custodian of the dome's integrity. He is initially framed in wide, isolating shots that emphasize his separation from the human scale.

As he engages in the transmission of forbidden knowledge, the camera moves into intimate, shallow-depth-of-field close-ups. The lighting shifts from the harsh, divine bloom of the exterior to moody, interior shadows, reflecting the clandestine nature of his unauthorized data transfer.
props: The 'Celestial Caliper,' a physical interface tool made of dark data-glass that Tamiel uses to measure and demonstrate the curvature of the dome. It does not reflect light but refracts the background, showing the wireframe mesh of the simulation when looked through.
Floating shards of 'hard-light' geometry that he manifests to explain planetary motion; these are not magical illusions but localized rendering errors he induces to show the math behind the sky.
card.prompt_block: A hyper-realistic, cinematic medium shot of Tamiel, the Watcher, standing against a dark, star-filled void that looks slightly like a high-resolution LED screen. He is wearing heavy, matte-black robes with the texture of carbon-nanotube weave, accented by faint, circuit-like patterns of pale blue light. His expression is stoic and melancholic, captured with a shallow depth of field that focuses sharply on his eyes while blurring the background into bokeh. The lighting is cool and naturalistic, reminiscent of a moonlit night, but with a harsh rim light that highlights the artificial perfection of his form. In the foreground, out of focus, are floating, translucent geometric symbols in Ge'ez, glowing softly like a heads-up display. The image quality is pristine, 8k resolution, with the texture of a high-end drama film.

phase_prompts.label: The Architect of the Dome
phase_prompts.summary: Tamiel stands as the sombre custodian of the simulation's sky, explaining the grid logic of the heavens to a human audience. He is a figure of heavy burdens, revealing the walls of the world.
phase_prompts.prompt_block: A photorealistic close-up of Tamiel, an ancient yet futuristic entity, his face illuminated by the cool glow of a holographic star chart floating just above his open palm. The chart is not a chaotic swirl but a rigid, wireframe grid of the flat earth dome, rendered in sharp lines of light. His eyes are downcast, conveying a deep sense of resignation and gravity. The skin texture is hyper-detailed, showing the tension in his jaw. The background is a deep, velvety black, suggesting a desert night, with the horizon line looking suspiciously artificial, like a matte painting. The atmosphere is quiet and tense, captured with the visual language of a serious character drama, utilizing slow-shutter aesthetics and high dynamic range to capture the interplay between the dark robes and the bright data overlays.
